g.text: Eight two-storey homes / 144 m² gross per home / lower gallery entrance and upper rear exit
For Blender blockout / proposed / not an as-built playable
Dimensions govern. All lengths in metres unless marked mm. Print A1 at 100%.
MAP REV 01 + DETAIL ISSUE B01 / 18 OCTOBER 2026
Hall x=4.50–6.00 = 1.50 clear. Lower exterior door only at z=8;
upper exterior door only at z=0. Clear width 1.10. The opposite wall
Remove [6.12, 2.08, 2.68, 3.84] from upper slab in home-local x/z.
Keep the top landing at z=5.92–7.80. Do not cut the whole 3 × 6
stair allocation out of the upper floor.
ST-H: two 1.20 flights; 20 × 0.15 rises; 9 × 0.28 goings per half.
Half landing 1.20. Upper and lower hall portals at z=6.50; both open
For southern homes use world z = home.z + 8 - local z. This includes
walls, windows, floors, floor hole, both flights and landing.
Recalculate normals after baking the mirror.
Home-local flight run z=3.40–5.92. Left flight x=6.18–7.38 rises
north; right x=7.53–8.73 rises south. Half landing at +4.50. Top
landing at +6.00. Stair tread/slab thickness 150 mm.
Leave at least 2.40 headroom; current repeated 3.00 storey / 0.20
slab gives 2.80 at landings. Place guards and rail posts outside the
1.20 clear flights. Test the actual capsule before adding art.
